basic_info.description: Tucked away in the gem of a neighborhood that is Midtown Terrace, one of San Francisco's true suburban enclaves. This four-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath home has been completely reimagined for modern living. The thoughtful open floor plan creates a seamless flow, ideal for hosting gatherings both large and small. Designer finishes elevate every detail, while expansive windows frame stunning ocean and mountain views that bring natural beauty into your daily life. The inviting living area centers around a cozy fireplace, perfect for intimate evenings with loved ones. Step outside to a private yard designed for entertaining and relaxation, offering the perfect extension of your living space. With its combination of style, comfort, and breathtaking vistas, this home embodies the very best of San Francisco living in a peaceful neighborhood setting.
